stories.headline: In a policy switch, the Fed says its October 2027 meeting will not see a vote on interest rates
stories.summary: The Federal Reserve announced that its October 2027 meeting will not include a vote on interest rates, marking a notable shift in policy procedure. This decision changes the scheduled voting calendar for future FOMC meetings.
stories.why_matters: Directly affects expectations around Fed meeting protocols and long-term rate policy transparency for markets.

stories.headline: Four tankers struck by explosions in Strait of Hormuz, Iran says
stories.summary: Four oil tankers were struck by explosions in the Strait of Hormuz according to Iranian reports. This follows earlier reports of an oil tanker struck off UAE's Ras Al-Khaimah with all crew reported safe.
stories.why_matters: Geopolitical risks in critical energy shipping lanes support elevated oil prices and macro volatility.

stories.headline: Sitting on big gains in Nvidia? Jim Cramer's advice on what to do next
stories.summary: Jim Cramer offered guidance on portfolio management for investors holding large Nvidia positions. The commentary reflects ongoing investor focus on mega-cap technology stocks.
stories.why_matters: Nvidia concentration and sentiment drive S&P 500 composition and equity market momentum.

concept.title: Geopolitical Risk Premium in Energy Markets
concept.one_liner: Strait of Hormuz tensions support crude oil prices near $100 despite broader equity weakness.
concept.explanation: Multiple tanker incidents in critical shipping zones (Strait of Hormuz and UAE waters) are sustaining WTI at $99.64 despite a 0.27% S&P 500 decline. Iran-related tensions and Middle East escalation create a structural risk premium that decouples energy from equities. With the VIX falling 1.97 points to 17.49, equity volatility remains subdued even as geopolitical tail risks persist.
concept.market_link: Oil price support limits downside risk to energy stocks and inflation expectations, while Strait chokepoint risks justify defensive positioning in energy inflation hedges.

narrative: US equities edged down 0.27% to 7577 as Treasury yields rose (10Y +2 bps to 4.88%, 2Y +5 bps to 4.56%), signaling tighter financial conditions despite a Fed policy shift on October 2027 voting. Geopolitical escalation in the Hormuz Strait kept crude near $100, balancing energy concerns against declining volatility (VIX -1.97 to 17.49).
